name: GhostHoverCard
description: Headless hover-card root provider composing delay timing, open state, and GhostHoverCardTrigger/GhostHoverCardContent context.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Milliseconds before hiding after hover/focus leaves the trigger and content.

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: When `true`, `Escape` dismisses the open card via `useDismissableLayer`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when `open` is omitted.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Omit for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: openDelay
props.description: Milliseconds before showing after hover or focus begins.

spec.evidence: Approved for minimal `GhostHoverCard` (GHO-100). Visual baselines use `pnpm test:visual:docker`.
